classification.difficultyReason: Identify radii from radius or diameter labels, apply the sphere volume formula and halve it for hemispheres.

content.prompt: Calculate the volume of each solid. Give your answers correct to two decimal places.

answer.worked:
A hemisphere has half the volume of a sphere of the same radius.

$\begin{aligned}V&=\frac12\times\frac43\pi r^3\\V&=\frac23\pi\times6^3\\V&=144\pi\text{ cm}^3\\V&\approx452.39\text{ cm}^3\end{aligned}$
